about.sum:
Serge DeNimes has spent fifteen years building one of London's most recognisable jewellery brands - built on quality, creativity, and passion.
Founded in 2011 by Oliver Proudlock - Serge DeNimes stands proud at the intersection of Rio de Janeiro's Carioca spirit, Nîmes’ heritage, and London’s grit. The brand cut its teeth in fashion before finding its home in jewellery in 2017.
Every piece is designed in London, constructed from 925 sterling silver, and hallmarked in the UK. Four collections a year, each with its own story to tell.
2011
Serge DeNimes began in the Summer of 2011, with a collection of t-shirts featuring photographs by Lena Proudlock, taken at the Rio Festival in 1978.
2015
We started creating jewellery in 2015, with a small selection of just 6 designs, including the best-selling Padlock Necklace & Cross Earrings, handmade in the Jewellery Quarter in Birmingham. However, the brand was still heavily focused on apparel design, including this special edition Wolf Bomber Jacket.
